store_rule: At least two independent durable stores; runtime sandbox and chat memory never count.
promotion_rule: Only a receipt with decision GATE_CLOSE_AUTHORIZED and RESTORE_PASS may be referenced by a successor HEAD.
concurrency: Single writer with expected-parent compare-and-swap; stale parent, duplicate promotion or changed bytes fail closed.
recovery: Resolve exact identities across attachments, persistent catalog and repository; rematerialize without scientific reselection; preserve exposure.
scope_separation: Engineering control only; never changes membership, thresholds, PnL, holdout, costs, fills or scientific decisions.
